While security issues dominated the headlines in the leadup to the game, the mood at the stadium was joyous with half-time shows including a rap performance.

title: Mbappé, Kane and Yamal top favourites list in wide open 2026 Ballon d’Or race
description: French forward Kylian Mbappé, England captain Harry Kane and Spain's Lamine Yamal are among the favourites to be crowned the 2026 Ballon d'Or winner at a ceremony to be hosted Monday for the first time in England in recognition of the first winner Stanley Matthews.

title: 'An everyday habit': 2.5 billion lines of cocaine snorted in England per year
description: PRESS REVIEW – Monday, October 26: Brazilian and international papers react to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's presidential election victory. Next: The New York Times warns that the war in Iran is entering a dangerous new phase. Also: cocaine consumption and cocaine-related crimes are surging across Britain. Finally, it turns out that wrapping children in cotton wool isn't the best parenting strategy.

title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years
description: Algeria’s parliament on Sunday approved a resolution to send troops to Niger, making the first time Algerian soldiers will be deployed abroad since the 1973 Arab-Israeli war. Niger faces persistent attacks by armed groups, including near its border with Algeria, and the deployment comes as Algiers and Niamey are building the Trans-Saharan Gas Pipeline after decades of delays.

title: Algeria’s military deployment to Niger: What’s behind the move?
description: This will be Algerias first foreign troop deployment in 50 years as the country shifts its military doctrine.

title: Palestinians are opening their doors to the displaced of besieged Hebron
description: Israels assault on the West Bank city has forced thousands of people to flee their homes.

title: Do Palestinians in Gaza expect anything to change after Israel’s election?
description: After years of war, displacement and restrictions, Gazans ask whether Israel’s election will affect their future.

title: Saudi Arabia confirms January start for Asian Cup 2027 despite attacks
description: Asian Cup 2027 to kick off on January 7 with Saudi Arabia facing Palestine in Riyadh as the AFC announces the schedule.

description: The International Weightlifting Federation becomes the first Olympic federation to choose Russia to host a world championships since its invasion of Ukraine.

title: Key European defence ministers meet in Paris to discuss Ukraine support
description: Defence ministers from France, Germany, Italy, Poland and the UK to discuss increasing military assistance to Ukraine.

description: Governorates Druze majority in deadlock with Syrian government.

description: AJLabs tracks how Israeli parties voted against eight Knesset bills that disfavoured Palestinians ahead of the election.

title: Thousands greet opposition leader Maria Machado upon return to Caracas
description: Thousands lined the streets of Caracas to welcome opposition leader Maria Corina Machado back to Venezuela after exile.

title: To Work With P.O.W.s, Ukrainians Suppress Feelings About the Enemy
description: Much has been said about how Ukraine should treat Russian prisoners of war. Less attention has been paid to the emotional struggle for the Ukrainians tasked with that work.

title: Israeli Jews Across the Spectrum Face an Election of Fears
description: Supporters and opponents of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have expressed intense anxieties about isolation abroad, security at home and the future of Israel’s identity.

description: BEIJING: China’s President Xi Jinping and other top leaders meet in Beijing on Monday at a key gathering watched closely for clues as to the country’s direction and future leadership.
